snippet.description:
Statistical analysis can help with many things, but trash talk is not one of them. Check out Squirrel Dash and other original CrunchLabs toys https://crunchlabs.com/BoardGames_Toys

Get your CrunchLabs box today: 
Creative Kit (Ages 6-10): https://crunchlabs.com/BoardGamesCK
Build Box (Ages 8-12): https://crunchlabs.com/BoardGamesBB
Hack Pack (Ages 14+): https://crunchlabs.com/BoardGamesHP
